description: This is a C++ source file implementing MKLDNN (oneDNN) optimized matrix multiplication functions within the PyTorch codebase. It contains conditional compilation directives for when MKLDNN support is enabled or disabled, including various functions for GEMM operations with different data types, as well as a placeholder function that raises an error if MKLDNN is not compiled in.
